info.title: API.SH: Wallapop
info.description: The Wallapop API from API.SH: public Wallapop data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Wallapop's category tree: id (the search's category filter), name, vertical, icon, the category's item attributes and its subcategories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wallapop-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Wallapop listing by link or id: title, description, type, price, categories, attributes (brand, model, condition...), characteristics, hashtags, location, views, favourites and conversation counts, shipping, reserved and sold flags, last change, seller id, link and photos. `include=seller` adds `seller`: the seller's public profile summary (name, url, image, seller_type, verified_seller, top_profile, badge, city, country, rating, rating_percent, reviews_count, items_count, sales, response_rate, activity_level, member_since).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wallapop-item

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The item id (e.g. pj94oldwko6e), instead of `url`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `seller` adds the seller's profile summary (costs more).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Second-hand listings on Wallapop (Spain) around a point (default Madrid), with sort, price range, category and distance. Each listing: id, title, description, price, currency, category ids and names, city, postal code, region, map position, reserved flag, shipping flags, refurbished and warranty flags, creation and change dates, seller id, link and photos. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (alone); null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wallapop-search

parameters.name: distance_km
parameters.description: Only listings within this many kilometres.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

The reviews a Wallapop seller received: rating (out of five) and score, comment, date, shipping or in-person, the reviewer (name, picture, profile link) and the item (title, category, image, link), with the average rating.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wallapop-user-reviews

parameters.description: A seller id or wallapop.com/user/... link.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
